# Studio Soulutions

> Studio Soulutions is the directory app for salon suite buildings: one link where visitors find every studio in the building, with each studio's card, services, hours, booking link and a suite map. An optional lobby kiosk runs the same directory, and every building's app wears that building's own name. Built and run by Hive-Rise in Surprise, Arizona.

Salon suite buildings hold dozens of independent studios behind one front door, and a walk-in has no way to know who is inside. Studio Soulutions gives the building one link and one QR code. Studios join with a two-minute form and their card goes live right away; after that they keep it current themselves through a code-protected studio portal, and changes go live on save.

## Pages

- [Home](https://studiosoulutions.com/): what the product is and who it is for
- [For building owners](https://studiosoulutions.com/owners/): how a building gets its own directory app, and how to get in touch
- [Get your studio listed](https://studiosoulutions.com/join/): how a studio gets its card
- [Salon Plus Studios](https://studiosoulutions.com/salonplus/app/): the first live building, in Glendale, Arizona
- [Privacy](https://studiosoulutions.com/privacy/): what the forms collect and where it goes

## Facts

- The product is sold to salon suite building owners; each building gets its own branded app, and pricing is shaped per building.
- Visitors install nothing: the app runs in any phone's browser and can be added to the home screen.
- Contact and sales run through Hive-Rise (hive-rise.com), the agency behind the product.
